howtos.title: Grant Claude permission when auto mode refuses
howtos.what: A one-line message that unblocked Claude chat after auto mode refused to run an experiment.
copy: I give this session permission to run this experiment (now try again)
howtos.whenToUse: When Claude auto mode refuses an action you intended, since it takes your messages into account.

howtos.title: Let agents ship behind flags, gates and metrics
howtos.what: A three-part flow for agent-written changes: feature-gated code, checks on push, then metric monitoring.
copy: Have the agent write the feature behind a feature gate.
Run verification gates on push, such as proof checking and security audits.
Have the agent monitor metrics after release.
On Vercel this can be done today with CLI commands like vercel flags and vercel metrics.
howtos.whenToUse: When you want agents to ship production changes with guardrails instead of manual review alone.
